mods.name: Stay Connected
mods.description: Keeps you on the server: auto-reconnects (retrying on a timer) and refreshes your Microsoft session token so reconnects survive the ~24h token expiry. Press R for the menu.

releases.notes:
Bugfix release — please update from v1.0.0.

## Fixed
- **Silent session refresh now works.** v1.0.0 could sign in, but the automatic refresh failed with `invalid_scope` because login.live.com requires a `scope` parameter on the refresh request. Without the fix the token would still expire after ~24h. Re-auth now refreshes correctly on its timer and on reconnect.

If you ran v1.0.0: just replace the jar and relaunch. Your saved login carries over (no need to sign in again).

## Requirements — play on this version
- **Minecraft 26.1.2** (Fabric)
- **Fabric Loader** 0.19.3+
- **Fabric API** `0.150.0+26.1.2` — https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api
- Java 25 (comes with the 26.1 launcher)

## Install
1. Download **stayconnected-1.0.1.jar** below.
2. Put it **and Fabric API** into your `mods/` folder.
3. Launch Minecraft **26.1.2** (Fabric) and press **R** in-game.

## What it does
- **Auto-reconnect** — after a disconnect (incl. "Connection reset"), reconnects to the last server and keeps retrying every *X* seconds until you're back in-world.
- **Session re-auth** — refreshes your Microsoft session token so reconnects survive the ~24h "Try restarting your client" expiry. One-time Microsoft login required (see README).

Full setup + login steps: https://github.com/sethstiles/StayConnected#readme

releases.notes:
Keep yourself on the server: auto-reconnect (with retry) + Microsoft session re-auth.

## Requirements — play on this version
- **Minecraft 26.1.2** (Fabric)
- **Fabric Loader** 0.19.3 or newer
- **Fabric API** `0.150.0+26.1.2` — https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api
- Java 25 (comes with the 26.1 launcher)

## Install
1. Download **stayconnected-1.0.0.jar** below.
2. Put it **and Fabric API** into your `mods/` folder.
3. Launch Minecraft **26.1.2** (Fabric) and press **R** in-game.

## What it does
- **Auto-reconnect** — after a disconnect, reconnects to the last server and keeps retrying every *X* seconds until you're actually back in-world.
- **Session re-auth** — refreshes your Microsoft session token so reconnects still work past the ~24h "Try restarting your client" expiry.

## The menu (press R)
- **Stay connected: ON/OFF** — master switch for both features.
- **Reconnect every (seconds)** — retry interval (default 30).
- **Refresh session every (hours)** — token refresh cadence (default 12).
- **Microsoft login…** — one-time sign-in for the re-auth.

### One-time Microsoft login
The game can't reuse the launcher's login, so sign in once: **Microsoft login… → Open Microsoft login page**, log in, then copy the resulting `login.live.com/oauth20_desktop.srf?code=...` URL from your browser's address bar and paste it back into the box → **Sign in**. After that it refreshes automatically and survives restarts. Full steps in the [README](https://github.com/sethstiles/StayConnected#readme).
